endpoints.description: Returns basic health status of the MCP server
Check if the MCP server is running and healthy
Get metadata about all available API endpoints including parameters, examples, and usage instructions for LLMs
Send an email with the specified recipient, subject, and body. Optionally include CC and BCC recipients.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Email body content (plain text or HTML)

parameters.name: cc
parameters.description: List of CC recipient email addresses

parameters.name: bcc
parameters.description: List of BCC recipient email addresses

request_body_example.subject: Test Email
request_body_example.body: This is a test email from the MCP server

endpoints.curl_example:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/send-email \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "to": "recipient@example.com",
    "subject": "Test Email",
    "body": "This is a test email",
    "cc": ["cc@example.com"],
    "bcc": ["bcc@example.com"]
  }'
